_comment: Conversation schema v2 (LOCAL_LLM_STACK.md section 3, point 3g; experiments/chat_general/RESULTS.md, 'Conversation schema v2'), one RunPod L4, cap $5. data: the v2 SFT mix (tools/chat_v2_data.py; 135,525 conversations, sha256 f5933a46...: smol-smoltalk's system-prompt rows, no_robots' system rows, glaive-function-calling-v2's tool rows, a 40k replay of lever 1). v2init: pk_sft_v1 (4d53c7ff... GGUF; safetensors uploaded as pksft) with 8 embedding rows appended, each the mean of the old rows (tools/chat_v2_vocab.py extend; the head is tied). sft: pk_sft_v2 = that + the mix under paperkiln/2 on the 16,392-token vocabulary (vocab_llama3_bpe_v2.gguf, sha256 d44f27b2...), T 512, train.sft_loss all, 8,000 steps x 16 (one pass in expectation over the training rows), lr 5e-5, warmup 200, cosine to 0.1, BF16 GEMMs + flash attention. evalv1 / evalv2: the placement measurement (IF-tiny + placement set + turn distance) on pk_sft_v1 (v1: a system message folds into the first user message) and pk_sft_v2, and the tool-call set on pk_sft_v2, all greedy, generated by ember's CUDA server at b49eb5c (EMBER_GEMM_TF32=0, EMBER_DETERMINISTIC=1), pk_sft_v2's replies re-scored by mtstudio score (tools/colab_chat/chat_v2_eval_vm.sh); the first launch generated with mtstudio chat on the pod at about 17 s a prompt and was stopped after sft came home. Uploads: pksft.safetensors, vocab_llama3_bpe.gguf, vocab_llama3_bpe_v2.gguf, chat_v2_mix_v1.jsonl.gz.
